citation: Shibayama, T. et al. 2013, Superflares on solar-type stars observed with Kepler I, ApJS 209, 5
note: 1547 superflares on 279 G dwarfs; dN/dE proportional to E^−α with α about 2; on Sun-like slow rotators flares of 10³⁴ to 10³⁵ erg come once in 800 to 5000 years; Abstract supports index about 2 and far higher rates on the most active stars.
